name: viewfinder
description: Shows the screenshots and images Claude looks at in a pane beside the transcript

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the Viewfinder pane when Claude looks at a new image. Off: use /viewfinder.

render.title: How to draw pictures
render.description: auto: real pixels where the terminal can, half-block colour cells elsewhere (herdr, tmux). image: always pixels. blocks: always cells.
